verdict.rationale: The forms page states that all business forms can be submitted by mail or in person, and the service-options page documents a drop-off-only 4-hour filing service in Sacramento, so a paper fallback rail exists. However, the evidence never shows the exact mailing or street addresses, any fax option or number, or specific form identifiers tied to each online task. Missing for 10: exact published mailing and drop-off addresses, fax channel and numbers, per-task form numbers or downloadable paper forms, and independent confirmation that the paper route works when bizfile is unavailable.
